description: This file defines the SubtitleManager class responsible for observing cues, managing translations asynchronously, and updating the UI with original and translated subtitles. It interacts with a TranslationManager to perform translation tasks.

classes.name: SubtitleManager
classes.description: Manages subtitle cues, optionally translating them asynchronously and providing updates via callback.

methods.name: processCue
methods.description: Processes a subtitle cue. If autoTranslate is enabled, initiates asynchronous translation and updates the UI with the translated text.
